description: This Java source file defines the LevelDBTypeInfo class, which manages metadata about app-specific types stored in LevelDB within Apache Spark. It includes nested classes for handling indices and key building, and references external classes for database operations and reflection utilities.

classes.name: LevelDBTypeInfo
classes.description: Manages metadata about types stored in LevelDB, including index handling and key construction.

classes.name: LevelDBTypeInfo.Index
classes.description: Represents a single index in LevelDB, providing methods for key generation, index value retrieval, and index updates.

methods.name: LevelDBTypeInfo
methods.description: Constructor initializing metadata for a specific type and its indices.

methods.name: type
methods.description: Returns the class type associated with this metadata.

methods.name: keyPrefix
methods.description: Returns the prefix used for keys of this type in LevelDB.

methods.name: naturalIndex
methods.description: Retrieves the natural index for the type.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Retrieves a specific index by name.

methods.name: indices
methods.description: Returns all indices associated with the type.

methods.name: buildKey
methods.description: Constructs a LevelDB key from components, optionally including the type prefix.
